description: Turns a size table, or a chart with gaps, into SizeRef chart format v1 from what the table states plus the answers you pass. Nothing is inferred from the numbers. Takes a size chart, never a person's measurements. Limits: one call per request; up to 60 sizes, 40 columns or measurements a size, and 64 characters a size label or measurement name; each table cell is read up to 200 characters. When something is left open it returns questions with the allowed answers instead of a chart. A page with several tables needs table_index. product_title decides whether hips are kept for long tops such as a kurta or a dress; product_text gives the fit when the table does not state it.
name: normalise_size_chart
title: Normalise a size chart
